text: `checks.json` holds only jobs of the `review` workflow (`trust`, `hold`, …) and no result of the `pr` workflow. It does not show whether the four proofs compile, or whether they assume only what `toolchain/allowed-axioms.txt` lists. The `oft check` result in the pull request body is the author's own report.

`refusal_decided_classic`, `decided_from_classic` and `must_exit_in_at_cfg_mono_classic` are at `projects/glaze/binary_reflection/proofs/lib/HaltsStmts.v:90-112`. The body says they are lines 29-51 of `projects/skcms/iccprofile_info/proofs/lib/Halts/HaltsBridge.v` at f92feaf8b7, copied unchanged. That file is outside this checkout. It cannot be checked here whether the lines match, or whether that file has Anthropic's two lines (which decides whether case 2 of requirement 7 applies).

`projects/glaze/binary_reflection/proofs/lib/HaltsStmts.v:4`: the `Modified by` line is true, but it leaves out part of the diff against `lib/TopHalts.v`. Requirement 7 counts a change of module names as a change.
The `Require`/`Import` lines (`:25`, `:29`) drop `TopProof4`, `MhDefs`, `UbMhDefs`, `AsImg` and `BoImg`. They add the four `images.*`, `Statements`, `TopHalts`, `DrvRootP`, `UbDrvRootP`, `AsBaseA`, `BoBaseB`, `Monad` and `Specs`.
`exit_code_in_any` is replaced by `HALT_CODES`, `halt_code_0` and `halt_code_2` (`:37-43`).
`must_exit_forced_of_root_f` (`:116`) and the doc comment (`:7-20`) are new.
Fix: add these to the line.
